title: Keith house's loggia columns a touch taller, ruled between two photographs
items: 1808 Prairie (1904): the entrance loggia's paired columns now stand 2.5 m from pedestal to capital, up from 2.45 m, with the beam and balcony above them riding up the same 5 cm. Measured in the 1888 Inland Architect photograph against the third-storey window right beside them, they read 2.5 m.

The 1888 and 1965 photographs had seemed to disagree by half a metre on these columns. Both actually show them at the same proportion to their pedestals; the gap came from the two fitted cameras, one drawing the loggia too large and the other too small.
